newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev depo rates stand flat amid low demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev depo rates stand flat amid low demand.

text.p: Trade was thin on the Bulgarian interbank deposit market due to low demand for funds as the money rates were unchanged from Thursday, dealers said.
"Trade is very thin as banks' lev liquidity is very high Demand is almost nil," said a dealer.
Interbank overnight lev deposit rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Thursday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 1.39 percent on Wednesday, up from 2.10 percent on Wednesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank raised its simple annual main interest rate to 5.50 percent from 5.42 percent, effective Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
